## Plugin reference

- Description: <UploadDropzone>: click, drop or paste one or several files into the attachments store — mime (accept), size (maxBytes) and count (maxFiles) checked before upload, uploading / error state, one onUploaded per file. Owns no focus: a host opens the picker through handleRef (a page block's Enter / Space) and arms paste (pasteArmed).
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/attachments.uploadAttachment`
    - `infra/attachments.UploadedAttachment`

    - `ui/icons.Icon`
  - Exports (types):
